preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 40, inclusive.
The number of ingredients is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
Each ingredient amount is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= g_i <= K for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each ingredient amount is an integer between 1 and K, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: max(g_1 ^ g_2 ^ ... ^ g_N for g in solutions) == max_possible_taste
postconditions.description: The maximum possible taste of the cake is achieved by at least one of the solutions.

postconditions.expression: all(g_i == g_j for i, j in pairs if i != j)
postconditions.description: If two ingredient amounts are the same, they are the same for all solutions.
